notes.title: Demo Patch V0.23
notes.notes: [p]Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu Demo V0.23 Patch Notes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where pausing game or using photomode while using a pineapple balloon causes the contestant to fly into orbit[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up some sora audio[/p][/*][*][p]Added new customisation options, tails, ears, backpacks![/p][/*][*][p]Improved baked lighting in Yolko Harbour[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cloth physics performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where cloth physics would briefly stretch toward the ground in an ugly way[/p][/*][*][p]Waving octopus arm hazard now is always emerged instead of popping up when players are nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem with loaded stages  ignoring user's volume settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added necessary invisible walls to Yolko Harbour[/p][/*][/list]
